threshold.value: infinity, provided that if a Ratings Event or Collateralization Event has occurred and is continuing, the Threshold with respect to Party A shall be zero, except that the Threshold in respect of Party A shall be infinity so long as (I)(i) no S&P Collateralization Event has occurred and is continuing, and (ii)(A) less than 30 Local Business Days have lapsed since the last time no Moody’s Collateralization Event had occurred and was continuing and (B) no Moody’s Collateralization Event had occurred when this Annex was executed and (II) a Ratings Event is not occurring.
threshold.evidence_quote:
“Threshold”
                  means, with respect to Party A, infinity, provided that if a Ratings
                  Event or Collateralization Event has occurred and is continuing, the
                  Threshold with respect to Party A shall be zero, except that the Threshold
                  in respect of Party A shall be infinity so long as (I)(i) no S&P
                  Collateralization Event has occurred and is continuing, and (ii)(A)
                  less than 30 Local Business Days have lapsed since the last time no
                  Moody’s Collateralization Event had occurred and was continuing and (B)
                  no Moody’s Collateralization Event had occurred when this Annex was executed
                  and (II) a Ratings Event is not occurring.

minimum_transfer_amount.value: $100,000; provided, however, that if the aggregate Principal Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to be more than $50,000,000, then the Minimum Transfer Amount shall mean $50,000.
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote:
“Minimum
                  Transfer Amount” means,
                  with respect to a party, $100,000; provided, however, that if the
                  aggregate Principal Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to
                  be more than $50,000,000, then the Minimum Transfer Amount shall
                  mean
                  $50,000.

rounding.value: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of $1,000 and the Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of $1,000.
rounding.evidence_quote:
“Rounding”.  The
                  Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple
                  of
                  $1,000 and the Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest
                  integral
                  multiple of $1,000.
